fact: Malawi's Minister of Homeland Security launched a Vital Statistics Report on 23 April 2025, developed with the National Statistical Office and the Ministry of Health, with UNDP backing.

The Vital Statistics Report launched on 23 April 2025 covers birth and death registration patterns for 2015 to 2022, from the government's first national rollout of birth and death registration, per the NRB Principal Secretary.

The National Statistics Office, National Registration Bureau and Ministry of Health published Malawi's first vital statistics report from civil registration records (births 2015-2022, deaths 2017-2022, with causes of death), launched in April 2025; the date is the month of publication, not the years the figures cover.
